allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Iris Clothings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Receipt of In-principle approval for issue of Equity Shares on Preferential basis under Regulation 28(1) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015'.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Iris Clothings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Allotment of Securities pursuant to Bonus'.

allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Iris Clothings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 22, 2025, titled "Rights Issue Attracts Strong Investor Interest with 1.5 Times Oversubscription".

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Iris Clothings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Rights issue'.Iris Clothings Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on March 07, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 1: 6, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 6 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 35 per share

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Iris Clothings Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on March 07, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 1 : 6, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 6 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 35 per share.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Iris Clothings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on December 14, 2024 approved the filing of Draft Letter of Offer with Stock Exchanges for raising funds through rights issue.
